Frequently asked questions

How do I create a token on Stellar?

Set a name, ticker, total supply and logo, then sign the issuing transactions in your wallet. LumosCore creates the issuing and distribution accounts and mints the supply to you.

Do I need to write a smart contract?

No. Stellar issues assets at the protocol level, so there is no contract to write, compile or audit. Issuing a token is a signed transaction.

What does launching a token cost?

Only Stellar network costs: a small transaction fee, plus the XLM minimum balance reserved for the new accounts and trustlines. LumosCore charges no launch fee.

Can I add liquidity for my token afterwards?

Yes. Once issued, you can create a liquidity pool pairing your token with XLM or another asset so people can trade it.
